sentences.text: Mosswood achieves higher test accuracy than Harrier-GCN on Sorrel-Cite (83.7% vs 81.4%) and Sorrel-Cite-XL (79.1% vs 76.2%), but lower accuracy on Tamarind-Social (67.9% vs 68.3%).
Compared with Kittiwake-Net, Mosswood is more accurate on Sorrel-Cite (83.7% vs 80.9%) and Sorrel-Cite-XL (79.1% vs 77.0%), yet less accurate on Tamarind-Social (67.9% vs 69.0%).
No statistical tests were reported, so the significance of these differences is not established.
